meta.title: Al-Mustafa Print
meta.description: Al-Mustafa Print: digital and offset printing, business cards, banners, packaging. See our work and order easily.

hero.title: Precise printing, delivered on time
hero.subtitle: From business cards to billboards. See our work, ask us on WhatsApp, and follow your order stage by stage.

promises.text: Order on the site and pay cash when you pick up, or when we deliver.

steps.text: The product and quantity, with the price shown at once.

steps.text: You see it on your phone and say yes, or ask for a change.

cta.text: Send us the details on WhatsApp and we'll reply with the price and the delivery date.
